# Data Type Reference

This page describes the internal type system of `Eliashberg.jl`, including the physical object hierarchies and the result data containers.

## Geometry

Core types for representing lattices and momentum grids.

```{mermaid}
graph TD
    AbstractKGrid["AbstractKGrid{D}"]
    Crystal["Crystal{D}"]
    IBravInfo["IBravInfo"]
```

| Type | Description | Key Fields |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `AbstractKGrid{D}` | Abstract base for Brillouin zone sampling (grids and paths). | - |
| `Crystal{D}` | Unitless internal representation of a crystal structure. | `lattice`, `fractional_positions`, `atomic_symbols` |

### Examples

```julia
# Construct a square lattice crystal
lattice = [1.0 0.0; 0.0 1.0]
atoms = [:Cu => [0.0, 0.0]]
crystal = Crystal(lattice, atoms)
```

## Dispersion Models

Hierarchical representation of electronic and bosonic dispersions.

```{mermaid}
classDiagram
    class PhysicalModel {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class Dispersion {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class ElectronicDispersion {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class PhononDispersion {
        <<abstract>>
    }

    PhysicalModel <|-- Dispersion
    Dispersion <|-- ElectronicDispersion
    Dispersion <|-- PhononDispersion

    ElectronicDispersion <|-- FreeElectron
    ElectronicDispersion <|-- TightBinding
    ElectronicDispersion <|-- MultiOrbitalTightBinding
    ElectronicDispersion <|-- SpinorDispersion
    ElectronicDispersion <|-- KagomeLattice
    ElectronicDispersion <|-- Graphene
    ElectronicDispersion <|-- SSHModel

    PhononDispersion <|-- EinsteinModel
    PhononDispersion <|-- DebyeModel
    PhononDispersion <|-- PolaritonModel
    PhononDispersion <|-- MonoatomicLatticeModel
```

### Electronic Dispersions

| Type | Description | Key Fields |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `FreeElectron{D}` | Parabolic dispersion model. | `EF`, `mass` |
| `TightBinding{D}` | Real-space tight-binding model. | `lattice`, `hoppings`, `EF` |
| `MultiOrbitalTightBinding{D}` | General Wannier-style multi-orbital model. | `num_orbitals`, `hoppings`, `EF` |
| `SpinorDispersion{D, M}` | Wrapper to promote a model to a spin-degenerate basis. | `bare` model |

### Phonon Dispersions

| Type | Description | Key Fields |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `EinsteinModel{D}` | Constant frequency phonon mode. | `ωE` |
| `DebyeModel{D}` | Acoustic phonon mode with linear dispersion. | `vs`, `ωD` |

### Examples

```julia
# 2D Tight-Binding on a square lattice
lattice = [1.0 0.0; 0.0 1.0]
t = 1.0; EF = -0.5
model = TightBinding(lattice, t, EF)
```

## Interactions

Hierarchical representation of interaction kernels.

```{mermaid}
classDiagram
    class Interaction {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class ElectronPhononInteraction {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class CoulombInteraction {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class ScreenedInteraction {
        <<abstract>>
    }

    Interaction <|-- ElectronPhononInteraction
    Interaction <|-- CoulombInteraction
    Interaction <|-- ScreenedInteraction

    ElectronPhononInteraction <|-- ConstantInteraction
    ElectronPhononInteraction <|-- LocalInteraction
    ElectronPhononInteraction <|-- YukawaInteraction
    ElectronPhononInteraction <|-- LimitedConstantInteraction

    CoulombInteraction <|-- BareCoulombInteraction
    ScreenedInteraction <|-- ScreenedCoulombInteraction
```

| Type | Description | Key Fields |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ConstantInteraction` | Momentum-independent interaction. | `V0` |
| `YukawaInteraction` | Screened interaction with $V(q) \sim 1/(q^2 + \lambda^2)$. | `V0`, `λ` |
| `CompositeInteraction` | Linear combination of multiple interactions. | `interactions` (Tuple) |

### Examples

```julia
# Combined attractice phonon and repulsive Coulomb
V_ph = ConstantInteraction(-2.0)
V_c  = BareCoulombInteraction(0.1)
interaction = V_ph + V_c
```

## Mean Field (Auxiliary Fields)

Symmetry-breaking fields and order parameters.

```{mermaid}
classDiagram
    class AuxiliaryField {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class ParticleHoleChannel {
        <<abstract>>
    }

    AuxiliaryField <|-- ParticleHoleChannel
    ParticleHoleChannel <|-- DirectChannel
    ParticleHoleChannel <|-- ExchangeChannel
    ParticleHoleChannel <|-- ChargeDensityWave
    ParticleHoleChannel <|-- SpinDensityWave

    AuxiliaryField <|-- BCSReducedPairing
    AuxiliaryField <|-- FFLOPairing
    AuxiliaryField <|-- PairDensityWave
    AuxiliaryField <|-- MomentumDependentPairing
```

| Type | Description | Key Fields |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `BCSReducedPairing` | Uniform superconducting gap ($q=0$). | `symmetry` (e.g. `:s_wave`) |
| `FFLOPairing{D}` | Superconductivity with finite center-of-mass momentum. | `q`, `symmetry`, `h` |
| `ChargeDensityWave{D}` | Static charge modulation. | `q` |

### Examples

```julia
# FFLO field in 1D
q = [0.1]
field = FFLOPairing(q; h=0.2)
```

## Result Payloads (Data Containers)

Objects used to store and visualize calculation results.

| Type | Description | Key Contents |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `BandStructureData{D}` | Dispersion curves along a k-path. | `kpath`, `bands` |
| `SpectralMapData{D}` | Collective mode or electronic spectral intensity. | `qpath`, `omegas`, `spectral_matrix` |
| `PhaseDiagramData` | Free energy and order parameters across $T$ and $\phi$. | `phis`, `Ts`, `free_energy` |
| `RenormalizedBandData` | Bands and gaps as a function of temperature. | `kpath`, `bare_bands`, `renormalized_bands`, `gaps`, `temperatures` |
